2607.08662.title: WebSwarm: Recursive Multi-Agent Orchestration for Deep-and-Wide Web Search
2607.08662.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM)-based web search agents are transforming information seeking from simple factoid question answering into complex, deep-and-wide search and research-oriented tasks. A single ReAct-style agent is constrained by one long trajectory and limited context, making it difficult to handle depth and coverage simultaneously. Existing multi-agent systems improve search coverage through parallel execution and aggregation, but still exhibit clear limitations in recursive depth, collaboration adaptability, and evidence-grounded expansion. We propose WebSwarm, a progressive recursive delegation framework that jointly constructs task decomposition, recursive expansion, and agent collaboration during inference. WebSwarm dynamically instantiates agentic search nodes, each coupling a local objective with a search mode that specifies how the node should organize search and collaboration. Each node can either solve its objective itself or further delegate child nodes; after solving, it returns evidence and results upward, enabling parent nodes to further expand, revise, or aggregate the search process. To guide this process, WebSwarm first probes how task-relevant information is organized on the web to ground subsequent node expansion, and reuses process-level experience across homogeneous sibling nodes. Experiments on BrowseComp-Plus, WideSearch, DeepWideSearch, and GISA show that WebSwarm consistently outperforms single-agent and multi-agent baselines on deep, wide, and interleaved deep-and-wide tasks. Further analyses of ablation, task difficulty, web tool efficiency, and model generalization explain WebSwarm's effectiveness and provide insights for multi-agent search systems.
2607.08662.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）為基礎的網路搜尋代理正在將資訊尋找從簡單的事實問題回答轉變為複雜的、深度與廣度兼具的搜尋和研究導向任務。單一的ReAct風格代理受到一條長軌跡和有限上下文的限制，使得同時處理深度和覆蓋範圍變得困難。現有的多代理系統通過平行執行和聚合來改善搜尋覆蓋範圍，但在遞歸深度、協作適應性和基於證據的擴展方面仍然顯示出明顯的局限性。我們提出了WebSwarm，一個漸進式遞歸委派框架，在推理過程中共同構建任務分解、遞歸擴展和代理協作。WebSwarm動態實例化代理搜尋節點，每個節點將本地目標與指定如何組織搜尋和協作的搜尋模式相結合。每個節點可以自己解決其目標或進一步委派子節點；在解決後，它將證據和結果向上返回，使得父節點能夠進一步擴展、修訂或聚合搜尋過程。為了引導這一過程，WebSwarm首先探測任務相關資訊在網路上的組織方式，以便為後續的節點擴展提供基礎，並在同質的兄弟節點之間重用過程級別的經驗。在BrowseComp-Plus、WideSearch、DeepWideSearch和GISA上的實驗顯示，WebSwarm在深度、廣度和交錯的深度與廣度任務上始終優於單一代理和多代理基準。對於消融、任務難度、網路工具效率和模型泛化的進一步分析解釋了WebSwarm的有效性，並為多代理搜尋系統提供了見解。
